headline: Minimum wage rises in Greece from 2027. What changes for hundreds of thousands of employees
summary: Greece will raise its minimum wage from April 1, 2027, affecting hundreds of thousands of employees. The gross increase will be accompanied by lower contributions, raising net earnings.
why: Minimum wage changes influence labour costs for employers and disposable income across the Greek workforce.
